scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/text-check.mjs && uv run --project packages/mkdocs ruff check packages/mkdocs && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run compile -w packages/docusaurus && npm run typecheck -w site
scripts.test: npm test --workspaces --if-present && uv run --project packages/mkdocs pytest packages/mkdocs --cov --cov-config=packages/mkdocs/pyproject.toml --cov-report=term --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser --workspaces --if-present && uv run --project packages/mkdocs mkdocs build --strict -f packages/mkdocs/example/mkdocs.yml && BUILDGUIDE_SITE=../mkdocs/example/site npm run test:browser -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/docusaurus && BUILDGUIDE_SITE=../docusaurus/example/build npm run test:browser -w packages/core
scripts.dist: npm run dist --workspaces --if-present && uv build packages/mkdocs
